steps.d: We feed the bot your services, prices, FAQs and tone, so it sounds like your business.
Your website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger are connected to one brain, with the same knowledge and tone.
We run through real scenarios and refine the answers until every conversation feels natural and accurate.
The bot goes live and is fine-tuned every month based on real conversations and new questions.

cost.label: What it costs:
cost.text: €50 a month on top of Online Growth (€150 a month). Together €200 a month, cancellable monthly. All prices excl. VAT.

items.a: No. We train the bot on your tone and writing style. It understands everyday sentences, with no rigid option menus.

items.q: What if the bot doesn't know something?
items.a: Then it passes the conversation on to you or your team and notes the question, so you can answer whenever it suits you. We set it up not to make up answers: if it isn't sure about something, it says so.

items.q: Which channels does it work on?
items.a: Your website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook Messenger. All run by the same brain, with the same knowledge and tone.

items.q: Can it put appointments in my calendar?
items.a: Yes. It shows your free slots and books the appointment straight into your calendar. Your customer gets a confirmation right away.

items.q: Can a chatbot do more than answer questions?
items.a: Yes. As a digital assistant, it can also ask questions itself and give advice based on the answers. At Clinic3D in Hasselt, the chatbot worked as a treatment guide: it asked customers what they were looking for and suggested the treatment that suited them best.

items.q: How much does an AI chatbot cost?
items.a: €50 a month, as an add-on to the Online Growth package (€150 a month, cancellable monthly). The extra cost covers the AI credits your chatbot uses. All prices excl. VAT.

items.q: How soon can the bot go live?
items.a: After the intake and training, we test thoroughly and go live. Usually within 14 days.
